name: payment-dunning
description: Charge a failed invoice up to three times (immediately, after 3 days, after 5 more days) with per-attempt retries and customer emails, then suspend the subscription.
author: orch8-io

workers.contract: Input {invoice_id, attempt}. Complete on success; fail the task (non-retryable) on a hard decline so the catch path runs. Must be idempotent per (invoice_id, attempt).
Input {invoice_id}. Suspends the subscription that owns the invoice. Must be idempotent.

requires: External workers for charge_payment and suspend_subscription polling queue `billing` (see docs/WORKERS.md in the engine repo).
An HTTP email API at context.data.email_api_url that accepts {template, to, invoice_id}.
